family.description: Family of bacterial proteins that are likely to be part of the Na(+)-dependent bicarbonate transporter (sbt) family. Members carry 10TMS in a 5+5 duplicated structure. The loop between helices 5 and 6 in Synechocystis PCC6803 is likely to be the location for regulatory mechanisms governing the activation of the transporter [[cite:PUB00075354]].
family.name: Na+-dependent bicarbonate transporter superfamily
